name: Skadovsk
text: Skadovsk (Ukrainian: Скадовськ, IPA: [skɐˈdɔu̯sʲk] , Russian: Скадовск) is a port city on the Black Sea coast in Kherson Oblast, southern Ukraine. It serves as the administrative center of Skadovsk Raion and also hosts the administration of Skadovsk urban hromada, one of the hromadas of Ukraine. The city had a population of 16,969 (2022 estimate).

depictions.name: Skadovsk
depictions.text: The Skadovsk (Скадовск), alternatively known as the Sultansk (Султанськ), is a central location in Zaton, appearing in long and long. In both appearances, it serves as a central hub for stalkers in Zaton, with its leadership contested by Beard and Sultan.
